description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git submodule absorbgitdirs'. It contains multiple test cases written in shell script with custom testing functions, designed to verify the absorption of git directories in submodules under various scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects successful execution.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified directory with a message.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or timestamp.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that a file or output is empty.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets global git configuration for testing purposes.
